Find Facilities Last Updated Within a Date Range
get.description: Returns facilities whose last updated datetime falls within the provided range. Both 'updatedAfter' and 'updatedBefore' must be provided and may be no more than six months apart; a wider range returns a validation error. Values may be an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or datetime; a date-only 'updatedBefore' is inclusive of the whole day. Each returned facility includes a 'lastUpdated' datetime.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Start of the range, must be no more than six months before 'updatedBefore'

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: End of the range, must be no more than six months after 'updatedAfter'

lastUpdated.description: The datetime the facility was last updated

message.example: Date range between 'updatedAfter' and 'updatedBefore' must not exceed six months

searchScore.description: A relevance score calculated by the search engine indicating how well this facility matches the search query. Higher scores indicate a better match for the specific query. The score is based on factors like term frequency and inverse document frequency, and is not a percentage or a fixed-range value; its magnitude is relative to other results for the same query.

items.description: A linear ring is a closed LineString with four or more positions. The first and last positions are equivalent, and they MUST contain identical values; their representation SHOULD also be identical. A linear ring is the boundary of a surface or the boundary of a hole in a surface. A linear ring MUST follow the right-hand rule with respect to the area it bounds, i.e., exterior rings are counterclockwise, and holes are clockwise.

GeoJSon fundamental geometry construct. A position is an array of numbers. There MUST be two or more elements. The first two elements are longitude and latitude, or easting and northing, precisely in that order and using decimal numbers. Altitude or elevation MAY be included as an optional third element. Implementations SHOULD NOT extend positions beyond three elements because the semantics of extra elements are unspecified and ambiguous. Historically, some implementations have used a fourth element to carry a linear referencing measure (sometimes denoted as "M") or a numerical timestamp, but in most situations a parser will not be able to properly interpret these values. The interpretation and meaning of additional elements is beyond the scope of this specification, and additional elements MAY be ignored by parsers.

coordinates.description: A single position (longitude, latitude, and optional altitude)

BasicAuth.description: Used only on `POST /oauth/token` to exchange your `username:password` for a JWT. All other endpoints require Bearer authentication.

BearerAuth.description: Required on every endpoint except `POST /oauth/token`. Use the `accessToken` returned by `/oauth/token` as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.
